log.text: Roadmap set: $1M booked by 21 Apr 2027. Daily + weekly autonomous runs wired to this file.

Weekly review #1 (day 2): booked $0 vs pace $806 (M1 $25k by 21 Nov). Pipeline 0 calls / 0 proposals / 0 pilots. No kill rule due (M2 checkpoint 21 Dec). Verdict: POUR services warm outreach + SH✡MER pilots; products stay frozen. Gate: Dave's warm names + price approval. Targets unchanged.

Dave: products-first, less work. Market research done: apps alone can't reach $1M by Apr (RevenueCat: 4.6% of apps ever hit $10k/mo). PROPOSED (pending Dave): packages $450k / services $350k / SH✡MER $50k / grants $100k / apps $50k; retainer ₪20–28k/mo; SH✡MER ₪5–12k/yr. Evidence range $150–400k. Targets unchanged.

Dave: dream big, use every product. Whole-portfolio research: 14 income lines, best case ~$965k, worst ~$127k by Apr. PROPOSED (pending Dave): every line at its high end + 30-day kill/pour test each; ads only for R&K. Chore Wars is now the only name on site (trademark check open). Targets unchanged.

SH✡MER Nature v277 on staging: flood/heat/lost guides, Israel-grid coordinates on SOS, group trip board for leaders, organizations pricing (Group ₪249/mo, Trip ₪149, council pilot ₪2,500 = same as SH✡MER), live waitlist. Sold as an add-on to SH✡MER pilots, not a separate push. Targets unchanged.
Dave locked retainer at ₪35–40k/mo; no warm names → outbound to startups funded Aug–Oct 2026 (Calcalist funding list). Targets unchanged.
SH✡MER warm names in from Dave: Ohad Shamur + Natan Levi (pilot leads), Dennis + Mishel Mitroni (endorsement). Messages drafted, waiting for Dave's approval; nothing sent.

Weekly review #2 (day 4): booked $0 vs pace $3.2k (M1 $25k by 21 Nov). Pipeline 0 calls / 0 proposals / 0 pilots; all 12 roadmap issues still in Backlog, SH✡MER pilot messages unsent since 22 Oct. Week went to LickPick (frozen product). No kill rule due. Verdict: POUR services outbound + SH✡MER pilots, product work paused until a call is booked. Targets unchanged.
Studio brain set up (3s-status/STUDIO_BRAIN.md). Now building the funded-startups outreach list with drafts for Dave's approval. Targets unchanged.
Outbound list ready: 31 Israeli startups funded Aug–Oct 2026 with draft messages. Waiting for Dave's approval; nothing sent. Targets unchanged.
Offer page staged (EN/HE, 3 packages, not linked from home, hidden from Google). NEEDS YOUR EYES before outreach links to it. Targets unchanged.

Dave: offer page must match site branding, prices too high. Rebuilt on the home page's own design; prices cut to ₪18k/mo · ₪24k · from ₪45k (benchmarks: in-house head of design ₪38–50k/mo gross; fractional ≈ 1.5–2 days/wk). Lower prices = more deals needed: M1 $25k ≈ 5 retainer-months or 4 sprints. Awaiting Dave's OK.

Full review: every product checked against repos, chats and notes. Board regrouped: 2 in focus (Services, SH✡MER), 7 built-but-parked, 6 paused, 3 retired/unknown. Stale lines fixed (TH now 8/8 features built, SH✡MER v280, new service prices). Added today's 3 moves + 4 open questions for Dave. Date stamp now shows the real check date.

Status check (day 6): booked $0 vs pace ~$4k (M1 $25k by 21 Nov). Pipeline: 8 LinkedIn connection requests sent 25 Oct (missed in the 25 Oct board, now fixed), 0 calls, 0 pilots. SH✡MER v292 live (locked-phone shake-to-SOS, Call-from-Mom). Twilio Fraud Guard confirmed on by Dave. LickPick got 2 more releases despite being paused; Dave's call needed. Targets unchanged.

Evening session. Play reality check in the console: the tester LIST has 14 people but only 3 have actually OPTED IN, so the 14-day production clock has never started — that is the real SH✡MER blocker, not the app. Added the US to the closed track (now live, review cleared same day) and added 2 Miami testers (wife's family) — first real US foothold. Verified SH✡MER is genuinely US-ready on Android: emergency numbers auto-switch to 911, English 135/135, SOS write-protection confirmed live. iOS is the gap — no build exists and no Apple account; found that INDIVIDUAL enrolment skips the D-U-N-S wait entirely, and Dave has a Mac, so the build blocker is smaller than thought. Strategy sharpened: the free app is the sensor layer, the Command dashboard is the paid product, and its value is density in ONE territory — so recruit an urban pocket (neighbourhood / community / school), not scattered users. Buyer ladder: yishuv (free PoC) → regional council or city KABAT → US federation (93 have full-time security directors; $300M/yr federal NSGP can fund it, but not pilots). New lead: HaShomer HaChadash via batel@hashomer.org.il (partnerships) — email drafted, NOT sent. Asaf Pharaoh ran their southern region until 7 Oct; best used as a domain advisor and a route to one southern yishuv, not as an intro (he left on bad terms). Targets unchanged.

Agents run: outreach batch 2 (10 notes) + 7 follow-ups drafted → Dave's to-do; SH✡MER Hebrew pilot one-pager staged; grants shortlist done: Innovation Authority Tnufa closes 9 Nov (up to ₪200k each, 2 apps: Trashure-Hunters + SH✡MER), drafts in progress; TH backend wake-up running. Targets unchanged.

Day 8: booked $0 vs pace ~$5.6k. Checked: Supabase for TH is awake; Mishel confirmed = Mishel Taroni (SH✡MER Nature endorsement unlocked); Twilio Fraud Guard on. Open on Dave: offer price call (₪18k vs ₪35–40k), Tnufa portal by 1 Nov, Play tester opt-ins (3 of 14), SH✡MER WhatsApps + 2 council emails still unsent. Added Play opt-in task with ready message to the to-do list. Targets unchanged.

Trashure-Hunters: free Supabase backend live, all 13 migrations + 3 edge functions, reward functions locked to the server (verified), staging web build signs up, signs in and reaches the map. Staging only. Targets unchanged.

Dave: no loans → Tnufa explained (grant; royalties only from sales), go/no pending. Prices set ₪24k/2d · ₪38k full · ₪32k sprint · from ₪55k DS +VAT (offer page updated, still unlinked). SH✡MER pilot messages on hold until Ohad/Natan roles are known. SH✡MER Nature outreach on hold until Dave tests it. Chore Wars = keep & roll (parent-side ads + family plan); LickPick = money product (Pro $9.99/yr). Lemon Squeezy now today-priority. New lead: Suzan Kagan (Rotary D-2490) for Trashure-Hunters. Targets unchanged.

STRATEGY v2 (Claude decides, per Dave): 1 Cash now = design services, new ₪120k Launch Package for just-funded startups; 2 Big contracts = SH✡MER (communities → schools → councils → US communities), Nature only as add-on; 3 Grants = Tnufa ×2 + Govtech + Rotary/CSR for TH; 4 Passive = LickPick/Brand Kit/Chore Wars get payments only, no new build until they earn (30-day test). Parked: Ezra, Milo, Fairent, R&K, J8N.IX, WH33LZ, AXIS. Honest range by Apr: $250–550k; $1M needs ~4 Launch Packages + 6 retainers + 1 council. Targets unchanged.

Afternoon sync: Alex (Chamelio) DM sent; tester reminder email sent by Dave; batch 2 = 6 of 10 connection requests went through (4 to re-send); 0 of 13 accepted so far (checked LinkedIn). Tnufa decided by Claude: GO on SH✡MER only, smaller budget (Dave pays 20% of invoices up front, gets 80% back from Feb 2027) — TH waits for the next round. Offer page getting product images, lighter sections and the ₪120k Launch Package. Targets unchanged.

Pricing review (Forrester + design-service benchmarks): publish exact price only for the fixed-scope Sprint (₪32k); show "from" for Head of Design (₪24k/mo), Launch Package (₪120k) and Design System (₪55k); full-time ₪38k moved to the call. Added a "Best for" line per package (stage + pain). Page still unlinked. Targets unchanged.

Offer page audit (live-verified): LinkedIn links on offer page AND home page pointed to a stranger (Dave Mark, Omaha) — fixed to /in/davemarkovich; Vibrant stat said "+68% retention" — fixed to "doubled patient retention: 68% vs 34%" on both pages; AposHealth role claim softened to what was done; page now opens in Hebrew; Hebrew/English titles, canonical, social preview and price data for Google added (page stays hidden from Google until approval); hero images 2.3MB → 0.2MB; Dave's photo added; retired SH✡MER Forest badge replaced. Prices unchanged. Targets unchanged.

SH✡MER: pilot page rebuilt (new hero illustration, brand icons, pink PDF bug fixed, studio email); pricing set (pilot ₪2,500 counts toward year 1; ₪9,900/₪18,000/₪25,000 by size; councils ₪2/resident min ₪40k; 2 free design-partner pilots); 4 role-matched message sets drafted, nothing sent; SH✡MER Command self-serve buying page staged (guided demo, plans, checkout, council quote), payments via Dave's existing Morning account pending 4 payment links. Gaps: live dashboard open without login; privacy page vs GA4 mismatch. Full audit of all staged pages running.

LickPick: 3.5–3.7 shipped (hiss fix with verified numbers, metronome first, design pass, "less" pass: one More row per step; Back button; self-updating file app). Business: packaging final (Free / Pro $4.99 once + a year Backstage / Backstage $9.99 yr / Class pack $29.99); app supports all three keys (mock-store test green). GTM plan + launch dates + post/outreach drafts written (marketing/gtm-plan.md, project doc lickpick-gtm). Community/creator/teacher target research running. Gate: Dave creates the Lemon Squeezy store (3 products) and approves posts + outreach texts. Targets unchanged.
